text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prove every newly added automated assertion**

The proof explicitly limits itself to seventeen assertions in one recall-benchmark test, but this commit also adds many automated assertions in files such as `tests/unit/testing/evidence-records.test.ts` and `tests/unit/review/sweep-categories.test.ts` without any isolating fail/restore/pass evidence. The repository's review contract makes one isolating plant per new assertion blocking, so this proof cannot establish that the newly added evidence and category-list checks actually detect their targeted violations. Extend the proof set to cover every new assertion or document an applicable exemption.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/017546a803dd073733d47d0f3fe73f3ffd072b5d/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
